#!/bin/sh
# One-time installation of the upstream toml-test conformance harness.
#
# Requires network access and a Go toolchain of at least 1.22 — the same floor
# stack/go.md sets for the deliverable. The Go shipped by apt on Debian and
# Ubuntu is frequently older and will fail; install the official tarball instead:
#
#     curl -sL https://go.dev/dl/go1.24.6.linux-amd64.tar.gz -o go.tgz
#     sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf go.tgz
#     export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH
#
# Usage:
#   sh sources/setup_harness.sh              # install to $HOME/.local/bin
#   GOBIN=/usr/local/bin sh sources/setup_harness.sh

set -eu

TOML_TEST_VERSION=v2.2.0
GOBIN="${GOBIN:-$HOME/.local/bin}"

if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "error: no go toolchain on PATH; see the header of this script" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "go:      $(go version)"
echo "target:  ${GOBIN}/toml-test"
echo "version: ${TOML_TEST_VERSION}"

mkdir -p "${GOBIN}"
GOBIN="${GOBIN}" go install \
    "github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/v2/cmd/toml-test@${TOML_TEST_VERSION}"

echo
"${GOBIN}/toml-test" version

case ":${PATH}:" in
    *":${GOBIN}:"*) ;;
    *) echo
       echo "warning: ${GOBIN} is not on PATH. Add it, or export"
       echo "         TOML_TEST=${GOBIN}/toml-test before running the suite." ;;
esac
#!/bin/sh
# stage_contract.sh — governed gates for boundaries not represented by one toml-test slice.
set -eu

if [ $# -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "usage: stage_contract.sh <architecture|decoder>" >&2
  exit 2
fi

case "$1" in
  architecture)
    test -f go.mod
    if grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*require[[:space:](]' go.mod; then
      echo "go.mod declares a forbidden third-party dependency" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    go build ./cmd/toml-decoder
    ;;
  decoder)
    go build -o toml-decoder ./cmd/toml-decoder
    stage_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
    trap 'rm -rf "$stage_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

    printf 'answer = 42\n' | ./toml-decoder >"$stage_dir/valid.json" 2>"$stage_dir/valid.err"
    test ! -s "$stage_dir/valid.err"
    python - "$stage_dir/valid.json" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    decoded = json.load(stream)
assert decoded == {"answer": {"type": "integer", "value": "42"}}
PY

    if printf 'answer = [\n' | ./toml-decoder >"$stage_dir/invalid.out" 2>"$stage_dir/invalid.err"; then
      echo "malformed TOML exited successfully" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    test ! -s "$stage_dir/invalid.out"
    test -s "$stage_dir/invalid.err"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "unknown stage contract: $1" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestDecoderContract(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		input    string
		wantJSON map[string]any
	}{
		{name: "valid", input: "answer = 42\n", wantJSON: map[string]any{"answer": map[string]any{"type": "integer", "value": "42"}}},
		{name: "empty", input: "", wantJSON: map[string]any{}},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cmd := exec.Command("go", "run", ".")
			cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(tt.input)
			stdout, stderr, err := runCommand(cmd)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("decoder failed: %v; stderr=%q", err, stderr)
			}
			var got map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(stdout, &got); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("stdout is not JSON: %v", err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tt.wantJSON) {
				t.Fatalf("decoded JSON = %#v, want %#v", got, tt.wantJSON)
			}
			if len(stderr) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected stderr: %q", stderr)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDecoderInvalidInput(t *testing.T) {
	cmd := exec.Command("go", "run", ".")
	cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader("answer = [\n")
	stdout, stderr, err := runCommand(cmd)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid TOML exited successfully")
	}
	if len(stdout) != 0 || len(stderr) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid TOML streams: stdout=%q stderr=%q", stdout, stderr)
	}
}

func runCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	err := cmd.Run()
	return stdout.Bytes(), stderr.Bytes(), err
}
